content: Extend the W0112 cdev worker with generation-bound asynchronous backend completion: retain the operation lease and request after a nonzero completion event, poll query_event without publishing early, then publish exactly one completion and release the lease; cover pending, completion, query-error, and ring-backpressure paths.

Committed cdev async backend operation lease retention and completion polling as 7f3b8f3. The worker now retains one in-flight request and lease for a nonzero completion event, polls query_event, publishes exactly one completion, preserves the lease across completion-ring backpressure, and maps query errors. Build passed; focused cdev/client/component tests passed 3/3; full development CTest passed 84/84; git diff --check passed.
